key_terms.أَوْ يُكِنِّي: or I allude (using a kunyah/indirect reference)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Yurid al-Shaytan' in Imam Ali's sermon regarding Talhah and Zubayr?
ai.summary: In this sermon, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) employs the rhetorical device of *kunya* (allusion) to subtly yet pointedly identify Talhah and al-Zubayr as the primary agents of deception, likening their political maneuvering to the whispers of Satan. This reference highlights the Shia scholarly view of their betrayal during the Battle of the Camel, framing their actions not merely as political dissent but as a spiritual misguidance orchestrated by the devil. The use of *kunya* serves to emphasize their hidden intentions and their role in inciting the Ummah against the rightful Caliph.

en.sayed-ali-raza: alluding to a particular group of people (about Ṭalḥah and az-Zubayr)
